In detail

Aluche shows a recurring pattern of theft-related press coverage: waves of burglaries and small-business robberies reported in 2020 and 2021, and a March 2024 report of arrests of a gang responsible for multiple flat break-ins including in Aluche. The documented concern is moderate and centred on property crime rather than a no-go reputation. Sources checked: Telemadrid, Dec 2020 & May 2021; Gacetin Madrid, Mar 2024.
